notes.title: PSF 2023 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
GM, Commissioner, and everything in between!
- Make choices for every team, automate every team, or select when to act!
- Every phase is wide open for you to manage to your level of detail or to automate!
- Change rules, goal posts, and more every season!
- Go back and watch past seasons!
- Change the names of playoff games and the championship game!

New and Improved stats:
- Improved realism and stats, especially defense!
- Tackles for Loss, tackles for safety, and more!
- MVP of the game
- Key ratings now include pass rush on LBs and blocking on RBs and TEs!

Redesigned weather:
- You can now set the start month of your league and each team's chance of snow!
- AND you can change these every season of your career!
- Weather now realistically follows the months of the games!
- Choose whether to display Fahrenheit or Celsius!

Even more customization!
- Set the locations and models of the goal posts for your league, and change them any time during your career!
- Three sleeves options, and the AI uses the teams preferences and the weather!
- Assign individual players' skin colors!
- More rules for different leagues!
- Includes college 2019 and 2021 rules, and the pro 2022 OT changes!

New game modes in career and season play!
- TV/Studio Mode - hop back to the studio any time to get updates on other games!
- Highlights Mode - enjoy the suspense of watching a game's highlights reel, but not knowing the results in advance!

Great user experience!
- Greatly improved animation sprites allow much more detail, including individual players' skin tones!
- Three commentary sound sets included, and you can add your own!
- New Referee voice over just adds to the pain of drawing penalties!
- Set individual volumes on referee calls, commentary, music, everything!
- Choose your own music folder and let random songs play, or select your favorite music!
- All stats screens are sortable!

Critical improvements from last year:
- Editor is much more robust!
- Improved AI and animation!

notes.title: Updates for Patch 101721 (major update)
notes.content:
This is a major update, lots of improvements and fixes.

[list]
[*] - Fixed major bug where changing audio or images in exhibition can wipe out a league
[*] - Fixed bug in Defense, switching call vs fieldgoals and punts
[*] - Fixed rare scoreboard bug when man returns from injury on a PAT
[*] - Fixed timing issue with offense calling timeout, getting incorrect message
[*] - New user option in Settings, to toggle AI suggesting clock options
[*] - Improved AI depth chart of defensive linemen for 4-3 and 3-4
[*] - Improved AI defensive clock management in closing seconds
[*] - Live Sim no longer pauses at OT stats if your setting has it off
[*] - Worked a LOT on the AI when just trying to get a fieldgoal to win, clock mgmt
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 (2022101001), 10/10/21
notes.content:
Please read the note below regarding viewing Player History from player cards!

Patch 1.0.9 (2022101001), 10/10/21
- Fixed bug in Defense, switching call vs fieldgoals and punts
- Fixed heading (season number) when exporting from past seasons
- Fixed/New: Restored Player History button on Player Card (but see below)
- New: New option on Settings, under Gameplay, to enable Player History from Cards
- New: Two more options for animation speed (much slower and slowest)
- Improved career leaders calculations for small leagues and for early seasons

I hesitated reactivating the "Player History from within Player Card" because people encountered problems from it.  However, enough people wanted to have the option that I worked on it (and I think I've fixed it), but decided to make it a user option in the Settings.

Player Card > History has been tested, but not extensively, so I suggest you back up your career initially, and let me know if you run into any issues.  NOTE: if you are already on a history screen and tap to view the card, you won't see the history button.

notes.title: Update 2022100301 (1.0.8), 10/3/21
notes.content:
This patch adds some new features and fixes.

- New: can now export season stats for past seasons!
- New: can now view player's career history from his player card!
- New: display FG chance on animation screen, good for Live Sims!
- Fixed player popups on Casual Defensive screen
- Improved AI logic when up by 8 and going for PAT

notes.title: Patch 2022092601 (1.0.7)
notes.content:
Today's patch should make College OT solid, fixes a bug in Casual play, improves the Play by Play output, and corrects some of the rules for clock.  It also greatly improves the AI in closing minutes.  Another big thing is improvements to penalties and more settings.

New settings include the ability to tweak penalty percentages, an option to always automatically load rules from the home league in exhibition play (good idea in general), and whether to retain the Motion setting between plays.

Patch 1.0.7 (2022092601), 9/26/21
- Fixed several issues with modern College OT
- Fixed older pro clock rules, and improved the Quick Set options
- Fixed bug in Casual mode if a formation isn't supported
- Fixed several issues in Play by Play
- Improved AI in closing seconds of both halves
- Improved penalties logic
- Added new setting to adjust penalties globally
- Added new setting to automatically load home league rules any time a different league is selected (exhibition play)
- Added new setting to toggle whether to keep Motion settings between plays

notes.title: Update notes for 2022091801 (1.0.6) [AI, Play by Play]
notes.content:
I've pushed this weekend's update, 2022091801 (1.0.6):

- Improved penalties for QB drop and Interference on screen plays
- Improved Play by Play:
  - now displays timeouts called and final score
- Improved AI in last seconds:
  - now knows whether to call QB Kneel, given defense timeouts
  - improved offense late in game
  - improved clock management
- AI now recommends clock options when you click to Suggest a Play
- Improved sync between animation and results on interceptions, etc
- Improved clock time taken in huddle
- Fixed Clock Dialog 'Last Play' option

There are still a few things I want to improve in the ai, and I need to work on the College OT.  I'll work on these next weekend.

I also fixed at least some of the "credit given to wrong player" issues and will keep an eye out for more.

Thanks!

notes.title: Hot Fix for bugs in League Editor
notes.content:
I want to work on some bugs this weekend - College overtime, AI in closing seconds, and possibly situations where the wrong man gets credit, if time allows.  However, I just found out that I need to be out a bit today and tomorrow (and possibly Sunday), so I want to push this quick Hot Fix to fix a problem I didn't see in the editor when in career or season play.

Basically, you shouldn't be able to do everything in the Career league editor that you can when creating or editing a base league.  For example, the game doesn't support changing the league structure in career play, but I somehow left that button visible, so I'm hiding that now.

I also threw in a few ten-minute changes:
- you now have separate "crowd sounds" options in settings for animation and other screens
- added Sim Qtr to Casual defense

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hot Fix, 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hot fix to fix some bugs and improve some features:

- fixed game crashing when scouting or trying to sub players on a 53-man exhibition game
- Fixed bug where teams' names were swapped on the final boxscore in the scoreboard
- fixed sorting Total TDs and PTs on team leaders screen
- fixed motion bug when changing formations
- fixed csv importer to accept only 43 and 53 man roster sizes (defaults to 53)
- fixed potential bug if league filename is too long for the character array
- fixed bug where receivers weren't appearing in the Total Yds and Total TDs leaders
- Added ability to Sim Qtr when watching a game live
- added sanity check to try to prevent career corruption
- disable several Career Options buttons in different phases
- added help text for League Level (age) in editor
- providing 43 and 53 man csv files now
